# Tickertwister Desktop support

Voor hulp met Tickertwister Desktop kun je Bob Ceulemans bereiken via [bceulemans@icloud.com](mailto:bceulemans@icloud.com). Vermeld je macOS-versie, de versie van Tickertwister en de stappen waarin het probleem optreedt.

For help with Tickertwister Desktop, email [Bob Ceulemans](mailto:bceulemans@icloud.com). Include your macOS version, the Tickertwister version and the steps that led to the issue.

You can also [report a bug or suggest a feature on GitHub](https://github.com/BobCeulemans/tickertwister-desktop/issues). GitHub issues are public. Keep your research dossier, passwords and OpenAI API key private.
